visual_reference: User reference for Tony Stark's private research workshop: rectangular space, warm grey concrete panels, inclined ribbon windows, exposed I-beams, pendant lights and precision equipment. Latest direction: sparse layout; no vehicles, armor, circular platform, red tool chest or grey-green bench lamp.
reference_usage: Architectural/material/layout reference; the film still is not shipped as a surrounding texture.
runtime: Six local PBR material images, two matched local generated exterior views and two self-contained local GLB models. Readiness awaits all assets. No external requests at runtime.

materials.floor: Smooth concrete, 2m physical map scale, neutral material tint, roughness variation, restrained rough planar reflection and derivative-filtered 2.4m expansion joints. Opaque PBR slab remains below reflection.
materials.walls: Individual 105mm precast slabs, 4mm edge bevels, recessed joints and form-tie plugs. Independent 4K color / 2K normal and roughness. Bitmap files unchanged.
materials.windows: Single-pass, transparent physical glass with subtle tint and environment reflection. Two world-space exterior planes show matched landward and bayward views of one coastal research campus; each 9.2m wide plane spans a whole side, preserves the image aspect ratio, and is placed outside the wall at x=+/-4.4m, center z=0.75m. No per-pane image repetition.

geometry.architecture: 7.6 × 8.4m rectangular plan, 3.4m height. Straight end walls; a short straight incline confined to the window bands. Physical slabs, ceiling panels, I-beam webs/flanges/end plates/bolts, pendant liners/rims/stems, skirting and one flush grille.
geometry.equipment: One rear writing desk with a rounded 36mm walnut top, suspended wood-front drawers, open knee space, adjustable feet, cable grommet and under-desk tray. Two 32-inch thin-bezel monitors, a mechanical keyboard, wireless mouse, stitched desk pad, notebook and pen. One full-size performance workstation with a transparent side panel, three intake fans, dual roof fans and radiator, CPU pump and hoses, motherboard, RAM, finned GPU, power shroud, ports and wiring. Orange task lamp attached by a C-clamp and rotated inward over the writing area. Desk props are generated in ../simulate-writing-desk.ts. One CAD-derived six-axis assistant on a controller pedestal. Central DKP bench has four fluted precision drivers in a perforated aluminium stand, a lined tray of threaded M3/M4 socket screws with matching thin flat washers, and a 150mm vernier caliper with measuring jaws, engraved scales, slider, lock and depth rod. Display tools are generated in ../simulate-workbench-tools.ts.

writing_desk.wood: Deterministic 2048 x 1024 lengthwise grain canvas with edge-continuous slab UVs and subtle bump; generated locally at mount time, no external texture request.
writing_desk.monitors: Two 0.708 x 0.398m active displays with 2048 x 1152 authored CAD/development artwork, unlit screen materials, inset glass, slim rear housings, vents, ports, tilt and aluminium stands.
writing_desk.workstation: Display-only authored hardware geometry, not a claim of a specific commercial machine or benchmark result.

geometry.interaction: Context does not enter raycast records, assembly inventory, connector occupancy or undo history. Removed main-bench lamp no longer reserves a desktop return slot.
geometry.batching: Static opaque meshes batched by material and shadow flags. Imported geometry, materials, image bitmaps and render targets owned per mounted scene; released on failure and scene switching.

artwork: Runtime canvas CAD and development illustrations on physical monitors; no live solver results are implied.
lighting: RoomEnvironment PMREM and neutral key/fill/rim. Inward-facing desk lamp has a soft warm spotlight positioned at the imported bulb and aimed at the writing surface, without another shadow map. Separate cached room shadow on a static layer excludes moving DKP meshes. Opaque floor has rough, low-strength planar reflections (1024 high / 512 balanced / disabled performance).

archived_generated_asset.processing: Copied at original native dimensions; no upscaling or generated-resolution claim.

historical_unused_assets: Earlier city imagery, foundry panorama/HDRI and laboratory observation image are not imported. The red tool chest was removed from source assets and production imports.

task_lamp.processing: Source mesh, UVs and 2K images repacked unchanged into GLB; physical base anchored at the clamp socket.

assistant.processing: Original 40,020 CAD visual facets and GLB bytes retained. Display normals keep 25-degree base creases and 35-degree arm creases. Continuous object-space PBR masks distinguish satin paint, inset panel, machined rims, recessed sockets and contacts. Original local positions are retained as a separate shader coordinate attribute through display placement. Derivative-filtered micro-roughness; no triangle-color or UV seams. Display environment only.

assets.processing: Original generated pixels copied unchanged. No resizing or upscaling. Native aspect ratio preserved on an exterior plane spanning the entire window band.
